sections.title: Structure
sections.md:
| Act | Lines | Job | Board group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hook 1 | HK1 | the worn joint shown calm — the cartilage isn't what hurts | Hook 1 |
| Hook 2 | HK2 | a bad-knee morning in Folake's armchair | Hook 2 |
| Hook 3 | HK3 | the consultant's finger on the narrow gap in the X-ray | Hook 3 |
| Act 1 | B-01…B-03 | the problem: three years with surgeons → bone on bone, a new knee → the walk, the stairs, the chair, every time | Act 1 |
| Act 2 | B-04…B-14 | the answer: it doesn't repair cartilage → the strain off the tendon → the same people doing the same things → features → proof → offer → close | Act 2 |

**Three finished videos, each hook + the same body (§30H):** Video n = HKn-01 → B-01a → MECH-S1 (split with MECH-S2) → MECH-01 → B-02b → B-03a → B-03b → B-03c → B-04 → MECH-02 → B-06 → B-07 → B-08 → B-09a → B-09b → B-10 → B-11a → B-11b → B-12 → B-13a → CARD-13b → B-14. **22 shots per video, 25 unique beats.** The body's cuts are identical in every video (`variants.py`).

**The payoff mirrors the problem:** Derek's walk (B-03a → B-14), Hassan's stairs (B-03b → B-06), Folake's chair and home (B-03c → B-07) — the same people, the same places, strap on.

**Casting balance (the script's ~50% Black):** people shots per video — Video 1: 8 of 16 Black · Video 2: 9 of 17 · Video 3: 8 of 17 (Folake, Hassan, the surgeon SG-01). ✓ **Boxed B-roll:** one split (EG03: MECH-S1 over MECH-S2) per video = 1 in 22 ✓. **Product first appearance:** B-01a (the box) in every video. **Screen direction:** Folake's stairs rise along the right-hand wall (P0), so her descent comes towards camera; Hassan's rise along the left (P3).

**Holds:** every shot is planned at ~2–3s (§30H, ≥ 2.0s); exact lengths come from the voice master (E6, `assemble.py --lengths`). Short lines ("You walk again.") are carried by one shot with the next sentence (B-07 covers the whole line).
